mapper.select: SELECT ts.id, ts.training_class_id AS trainingClassId, ts.session_no AS sessionNo, ts.topic, ts.content, ts.start_time AS startTime, ts.end_time AS endTime, ts.location, ts.instructor_id AS instructorId, u.real_name AS instructorName, ts.status FROM t_training_session ts JOIN t_user u ON u.id = ts.instructor_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ts.training_class_id = #{trainingClassId} AND ts.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ts.session_no, ts.start_time, ts.id
